english.title: Handle / control / transfer controlled waste without taking reasonable measures - Environmental Protection Act 1990.
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a

(A)_[person who imported, produced, carried, kept, treated or disposed of controlled waste failed to]_
(B)_[dealer or broker who had control of controlled waste failed to]_

(C)_[take all reasonable measures to prevent a contravention of section 33 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 by the unauthorised or harmful depositing, treatment or disposal of waste]_
(D)_[take all reasonable measures to prevent a contravention by another person of regulation 12 of the Pollution Prevention and Control (England and Wales) Regulations 2007 or a condition of an environmental permit]_
(E)_[take all reasonable measures to prevent the escape of waste from your control or from the control of another person]_
(F)_[secure on the transfer of waste that the transfer was to an authorised person or to a person for authorised transport purposes and that there was transferred such a written description of the waste as would enable other persons to avoid a contravention of section 33 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 or regulation 12 of the Pollution Prevention and Control (England and Wales) Regulations 2007 and to comply with their duty under section 34 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 as respects the escape of waste]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34(1) and (6) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i)Note - this document has been end-dated on the 13th March 2015 due to system constraints. This offence applies between 6th April 2008 and 5th April 2010 due to changes made by SI 2007/3538 Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2007/3538. For the offence applying after the 5th April 2010, see H23093.
(ii) Section 34(2) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 provides that the duty imposed by section 34(1) does not apply to an occupier of domestic property as respects the household waste produced on the property.
